title: Pi Hole Ad Blocker with Pi Zero W
creator: Adafruit

source.robots_txt: learn.adafruit.com robots.txt has no Disallow rules for User-agent: *
source.method: one curl GET; parts list transcribed by hand from the fetched text

gold_bom.name: 5V 2.5A micro USB power supply
gold_bom.notes: Guide lists both a 5V 1A USB supply (#501) and a 5V 2.5A micro-USB supply (#1995); one is needed.

gold_bom.name: 2x20 male header
gold_bom.notes: Needed only with the Pi Zero W; hammer headers are the solderless alternative.

gold_bom.name: microSD card
gold_bom.notes: Implied ('a way to burn that SD card'); part of the budget pack.

acceptable: Indian 5 V 2.5 A micro-USB adapter (Type D plug, BIS marked)
gold_substitutions.notes: Case 12 is a 12 V 2 A adapter; applied here by analogy to a US-plug 5 V adapter. Reviewer: confirm or drop.

notes: Parts from the 'Project Parts' page. The budget pack (#3410) bundles Pi Zero W, case, SD card, cables and headers; it is listed as one alternative, not extra.
ambiguities: Budget pack vs individual parts: gold uses the individual parts.
PiOLED and headers are optional; kept because the guide's later pages build them.
Mini PiTFT (#4393) page is an alternative display; not included.
Pi 3/4 can replace the Pi Zero W; not included as a separate line.
